description: Cross-SDK conformance for local activities, worker sessions, sticky execution, and truthful refusal.

capability_manifest_truth.expected_behavior: every runtime declares supported or explicitly refused for all three features, and flat routing capabilities exactly match supported manifest entries

local_activity_replay.expected_behavior: a supported worker records attempts and one terminal outcome atomically, and replay observes the result without repeating the side effect

session_holder_loss_and_reacquisition.expected_behavior: holder loss releases capacity, reacquisition obeys requirements and TTL, and worker-local resources are rebuilt before use

sticky_hit.expected_behavior: an exact identity cache hit increments hit while workflow output remains identical to full durable replay

sticky_eviction.expected_behavior: bounded capacity evicts an entry and its next execution uses full durable replay

worker_replacement.expected_behavior: worker replacement clears stale affinity and forces cold replay before execution

forced_cold_replay.expected_behavior: expiry, cache miss, holder loss, or build mismatch uses complete durable history and reports forced cold replay

zero_configuration_defaults.expected_behavior: ordinary workflows complete correctly without session or sticky configuration
